description: 《Counting Stars》描寫一個人在現實壓力與人生夢想之間，渴望尋找真正幸福的矛盾心情。歌中的主角經常因思考未來而難以入睡，逐漸開始懷疑金錢與世俗成功是否真的能帶來滿足。他厭倦一味遵從別人的期望，希望勇敢突破限制，追尋更自由、更有意義的生活。歌曲以金錢與繁星形成鮮明對比，象徵物質財富與內心夢想之間的選擇。即使面對挫折與不確定，他仍然渴望改變，尋找屬於自己的方向。最終，《Counting Stars》傳達的是對自由、夢想與人生價值的追尋：與其將生命耗費在無止境的物質競爭中，不如珍惜真正重要的事物，勇敢追求內心嚮往的幸福與未來。

vocabulary.usage: 談最近一段時間發生或持續的事，常與現在完成式一起使用。
options: I will meet my cousin lately at six tomorrow.
The astronaut put lately inside her bag before the trip.
Lately, our class has been making short films after school.
Our school play starts at lately on Friday.
optionExplanations: lately 不是特定的未來時間；明天六點可以說 *at six tomorrow*。
lately 是時間副詞，不是可以放進背包的物品。
lately 表示最近一段時間；這句是在說班上最近放學後都在拍短片。
lately 不是鐘點，不能放在 *at* 後面表示開演時間。
vocabulary.explanation: lately 表示最近一段時間；這句是在說班上最近放學後都在拍短片。

vocabulary.meaning: 睡不好、因為擔心而失眠。
vocabulary.usage: 當某件事讓你擔心到睡不好時，可以用 *lose sleep over/about something*。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “lose sleep”？
options: We lost sleep at the train station and asked the driver to find it.
The actor lost sleep on the stage, so the audience took it home.
She lost sleep into her phone to send a message.
My brother lost sleep because he was worried about his first job interview.
optionExplanations: sleep 不是遺失在車站、可以請人找回的東西；*lose sleep* 是睡不好。
sleep 不是觀眾能從舞台帶回家的物品。
*lose sleep* 不能表示傳訊息；要說 *send a message on her phone*。
面試讓哥哥擔心到睡不好，符合 *lose sleep* 的用法。
vocabulary.explanation: 面試讓哥哥擔心到睡不好，符合 *lose sleep* 的用法。

vocabulary.usage: 可以說睡覺時夢見的事，也可以說自己希望未來發生的事；後面接名詞或動詞 **-ing**。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “dream about”？
options: My friend dreams about becoming a pilot and flying around the world.
I dreamed about to become the mayor of our town.
The museum dreamed about open at nine every day.
Please dream about the window because the room is hot.
optionExplanations: *dreams about becoming* 正確表示夢想成為飛行員。
*dream about* 後接動詞時要用 -ing，應說 *dreamed about becoming*。
博物館的營業時間不是「做夢」；應說 *The museum opens at nine*。
想請人開窗應說 *Please open the window*，不是 *dream about*。
vocabulary.explanation: *dreams about becoming* 正確表示夢想成為飛行員。

vocabulary.usage: 數票、數人數、數星星，或確認物品有多少個時使用。
options: The singer counted her song louder so everyone could hear.
We counted 28 people on the bus before we left the zoo.
Please count the door before you leave the room.
He counted his friend happy with a new haircut.
optionExplanations: 讓歌曲更大聲應用 *sing louder*，不是 *count*。
這句是在出發前數公車上的人數，正確使用 *counted*。
離開時如果要把門關上，應說 *close the door*；*count the door* 不符合這個情境。
這裡想說讓朋友開心，可以說 *made his friend happy*；*counted* 不是這個意思。
vocabulary.explanation: 這句是在出發前數公車上的人數，正確使用 *counted*。

vocabulary.usage: 主動尋找特別的人、地方或機會，比一般的 *look for* 更強調努力。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “seek out”？
options: The young artist sought out a teacher who could help her paint better.
We seeked out the football because the match starts at three.
I seek out my hair every day with a small brush.
They sought out loudly when their team won the match.
optionExplanations: 藝術家主動尋找能幫助自己的老師，符合 *seek out* 的意思。
*seek* 的過去式是 *sought*，不是 *seeked*；如果只是找球，也可說 *looked for the football*。
梳頭髮要用 *brush my hair*，不是 *seek out my hair*。
球隊贏球時大聲喊叫應說 *shouted loudly*；*seek out* 是尋找。
vocabulary.explanation: 藝術家主動尋找能幫助自己的老師，符合 *seek out* 的意思。

vocabulary.usage: 形容有人敢提出意見、嘗試新事物或做出勇敢的決定。
options: My train is bold because it arrives at half past eight.
I put three bolds in the camera to take a photo.
It was bold of Mia to sing alone in front of 500 people.
The weather is bold at 20 degrees, so I need a jacket.
optionExplanations: 火車的時間不是勇敢或大膽；可說 *My train arrives at half past eight*。
*bold* 是形容詞，不是可以數三個、放進相機的東西。
Mia 敢獨自在 500 人面前唱歌，這是大膽的行為。
20 度是溫度，不能用 *bold* 描述；可以用 *cool* 或 *warm*。
vocabulary.explanation: Mia 敢獨自在 500 人面前唱歌，這是大膽的行為。

vocabulary.meaning: 被說服、覺得某個想法很好。
vocabulary.usage: 表示你接受或支持某個計畫、主意或選擇；這裡不是「被賣掉」。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “be sold on”？
options: My aunt was sold on Tuesday for twenty dollars.
I wasn't sold on the idea of camping until I saw the beautiful lake.
The football was sold on happy after the game.
We were sold on the train because all the seats were full.
optionExplanations: *be sold on* 在本題是「被某個想法說服」，不是拿來說人被出售。
一開始不喜歡露營的主意，看到湖後改變看法，正確使用 *sold on*。
*happy* 不是可以用 *be sold on* 支持的具體想法，這句也不通順。
座位滿了可以說 *The train was full*；*sold on* 不表示「擠在火車上」。
vocabulary.explanation: 一開始不喜歡露營的主意，看到湖後改變看法，正確使用 *sold on*。

vocabulary.meaning: 照別人的指示做、聽話照做。
vocabulary.usage: 老師、教練或主管給出指示時，可用來描述是否照著做；也可用來談獨立思考。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “do what you're told”？
options: I did what I was told into the cinema at seven o'clock.
During the fire practice, we did what we were told and walked outside calmly.
The radio did what it was told blue last night.
The painting did what it was told because it was expensive.
optionExplanations: *do what you're told* 是照指示行動，不能直接接 *into the cinema* 當作移動動詞。
火警演習時大家照指示冷靜走出去，正確使用這個片語。
這句的 *blue* 無法接在 *told* 後面表示指示內容，語意也不完整。
畫作不能照指示採取行動；*expensive* 也不能解釋這個片語。
vocabulary.explanation: 火警演習時大家照指示冷靜走出去，正確使用這個片語。

vocabulary.meaning: 感覺充滿活力、真切感受到生活。
vocabulary.usage: 做喜歡的事、迎接新挑戰或感到很興奮時可以使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “feel alive”？
options: I feel alive the meeting at nine, so please don't be late.
She feels alive her passport at the airport desk.
They felt alive the email and sent it to the manager.
Performing on stage with my band makes me feel alive.
optionExplanations: *feel alive* 不能直接接會議來表示安排時間；可說 *The meeting is at nine*。
在機場出示護照應用 *showed her passport*，不是 *feels alive*。
寄電子郵件應用 *sent the email*，不是 *felt alive the email*。
在舞台上和樂團演出讓人充滿活力，很適合用 *feel alive*。
vocabulary.explanation: 在舞台上和樂團演出讓人充滿活力，很適合用 *feel alive*。

vocabulary.meaning: 學到教訓、從經驗中學會一件事。
vocabulary.usage: 犯錯、遇到困難或經歷事件後，明白以後該怎麼做。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了 “learn a lesson”？
options: I learned a lesson when I forgot my lines in the play: practice before the show.
The chef learned a lesson into the oven for twenty minutes.
She learned a lesson to the bank and asked for ten dollars.
The pilot learned a lesson purple when the plane arrived.
optionExplanations: 忘記台詞後懂得演出前要練習，這就是從錯誤中學到教訓。
烤箱裡放食物應用 *put something in the oven*；*learn a lesson* 不是烹調動作。
去銀行借錢可以說 *went to the bank* 或 *borrowed money*，不能說 *learned a lesson to the bank*。
*purple* 是顏色，不能這樣接在 *learned a lesson* 後表示學到教訓。
vocabulary.explanation: 忘記台詞後懂得演出前要練習，這就是從錯誤中學到教訓。

錯誤。把祈禱當成讓馬鈴薯自行烤熟的方法，誤解了 pray hard 的作用。
錯誤。電池不會長腳；句子雖可讀懂，但祈禱內容刻意荒謬。
questions.explanation: 正確。家人懇切祈求走失的狗能平安回來。

questions.meaning: 藤蔓；攀緣植物的莖
questions.usage: 談花園、森林或會攀附生長的植物時使用。歌曲將 vine 放在人生的比喻中。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「vine」（以上述意思為準）？
options: The vine rang the doorbell before delivering our new sofa.
The vine climbed the wall and covered the old window.
The vine cooked our soup while the gardener was away.
The vine barked at the postman all afternoon in the garden.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。藤蔓不是送貨員；把它描寫成會按門鈴送沙發的角色十分荒謬。
正確。藤蔓沿著牆生長，最後蓋住了舊窗戶。
錯誤。藤蔓不會煮湯；句子雖有正常語序，語意卻不合理。
錯誤。植物不會像狗一樣吠叫，即使藤蔓出現在花園裡。
questions.explanation: 正確。藤蔓沿著牆生長，最後蓋住了舊窗戶。

questions.meaning: 越過界線；跨越某條線
questions.usage: 可以表示跨越實際界線，也可能在語境中比喻超出原本的限制。注意 cross the line 另常表示「越界、行為過分」，不應混為一談。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「across the line」（以上述意思為準）？
options: The cat leaped across the line to impress a potato.
The singer stepped across the line to swallow a rainbow.
The runner stepped across the line after the race ended.
The teacher danced across the line inside her coffee cup.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。貓跨越界線來討好馬鈴薯，語法雖通，情境刻意荒謬。
錯誤。這句雖然有跨過線的動作，但「為了吞下彩虹」是刻意不合理的情境；不考這種幻想作為正常用法。
正確。跑者跨過了畫在地上的線，符合跨越界線的意思。
錯誤。杯子裡不可能有供人跳舞跨越的地面界線；情境刻意荒謬。
questions.explanation: 正確。跑者跨過了畫在地上的線，符合跨越界線的意思。

questions.meaning: 閃爍的；快速亮起又熄滅的
questions.usage: 描述警示燈、電子標誌或突然閃現的光時使用；也可比喻某些訊息在腦中迅速出現。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「flashing」（以上述意思為準）？
options: The flashing soup blinked brightly while the chef stirred it.
The flashing shoes warned drivers to stop at the crossing.
The flashing pillow rang loudly when the class began.
The flashing sign warned drivers to slow down at night.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。湯本身通常不會像燈號一樣閃爍；這是誇張的荒謬意象。
錯誤。有 LED 的閃光鞋可能存在，但鞋子不會主動向駕駛發出交通警告。
錯誤。枕頭不是鐘聲或警鈴；這句用 flashing 卻描述聲響，混淆視覺與聽覺。
正確。閃爍的標誌提醒駕駛夜間減速。
questions.explanation: 正確。閃爍的標誌提醒駕駛夜間減速。

questions.meaning: 你們終將找到；你們必將發現
questions.usage: ye 和 shall 帶有古典、宗教或刻意仿古的語氣。一般現代對話通常說 you will find，而不是 ye shall find。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「ye shall find」（以上述意思為準）？
options: Our dog heard “Ye shall find” and started digging for bones.
The mechanic said “Ye shall find” to describe a loose bolt.
In the old tale, the guide said, “Seek, and ye shall find.”
At the café, a customer said “Ye shall find” to order milk.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。狗可能聽見人說話，但把這句仿古格言當作挖骨頭指令並不自然。
錯誤。機械師不會用「你們必將找到」來描述螺栓鬆動；語用不合。
正確。古老故事中的嚮導使用仿古語氣，符合這個表達的語域。
錯誤。用仿古句型點牛奶非常不自然；它不是咖啡店的商品名稱。
questions.explanation: 正確。古老故事中的嚮導使用仿古語氣，符合這個表達的語域。

questions.meaning: 四個字母的字；也常委婉指粗話或禁忌字眼
questions.usage: 字面指由四個字母組成的英文單字；慣用時常暗指粗俗字眼。歌曲以 hope 這個四字母詞製造反差。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「four-letter word」（以上述意思為準）？
options: Grandma called that rude term a four-letter word at dinner.
The pilot called every runway a four-letter word during landing.
The baker called a loaf of bread a four-letter word.
The gardener called his favourite flower a four-letter word.
optionExplanations: 正確。這裡的 four-letter word 委婉指不禮貌的粗俗字眼。
錯誤。跑道不是粗話；把每條跑道都叫 four-letter word 不符合這個慣用語。
錯誤。麵包不是藉由四字母粗話來分類；這裡誤把術語當商品名稱。
錯誤。花朵不是粗話；這裡沒有恰當使用 four-letter word 的慣用含義。
questions.explanation: 正確。這裡的 four-letter word 委婉指不禮貌的粗俗字眼。

questions.meaning: 眼看某物燃燒；在語境中暗示眼看資源被耗盡
questions.usage: 字面用於看著東西燃燒；歌曲與 money 搭配，可能暗示金錢被揮霍或失去價值。比喻義須由上下文判斷。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「watch it burn」（以上述意思為準）？
options: She watched it burn while the cold ice cream melted.
The actor watched it burn while the train left the station.
We watched it burn when the tickets arrived by email.
He spent his savings in a week and watched it all burn.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。冰淇淋是在融化，不是在燃燒；此處應說 melt。
錯誤。火車離站不代表有東西燃燒；watch it burn 在此無合理指涉。
錯誤。電子郵件送到機票不代表燃燒；watch it burn 的語意不成立。
正確。花光積蓄後，以 burn 比喻金錢迅速消耗，符合歌曲的意象。
questions.context: 程度參考：B2（語境中的比喻）
questions.explanation: 正確。花光積蓄後，以 burn 比喻金錢迅速消耗，符合歌曲的意象。

questions.meaning: 下沉；沉入水中
questions.usage: 船、石頭或物品往水底沉下時使用，也可比喻情緒或希望低落。別把 sink 誤當成 swim。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「sink」（以上述意思為準）？
options: The heavy stone began to sink in the deep pond.
The tiny boat began to sink toward the mountain peak.
The sandwich began to sink through the wooden kitchen table.
The suitcase began to sink when the music grew louder.
optionExplanations: 正確。沉重的石頭開始沉入池塘，正是 sink 的字面意思。
錯誤。山峰在上方；船往山頂「下沉」的方向矛盾。
錯誤。三明治穿過堅硬木桌下沉通常不符合真實物理情境。
錯誤。行李箱不會因音樂變大聲就自行下沉；原因搭配不合理。
questions.explanation: 正確。沉重的石頭開始沉入池塘，正是 sink 的字面意思。

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.meaning: 表示某個動作從最近開始，一直持續或反覆發生。
questions.usage: 描述最近一段時間持續進行的活動或情況。
questions.prompt: 哪一句用這個結構自然描述最近持續發生的情況？
options: Lately, I have been swimming every morning, but I have not been in water for a year.
Lately, I have been visiting the moon every Tuesday by bus.
Lately, she has been learning piano, but she has never started her first lesson.
Lately, our garden has been getting more butterflies. We see more each week.
optionExplanations: 後面說一年沒碰水，與每天游泳互相矛盾。
月球不是可以搭公車定期前往的地方，情境荒謬。
聲稱一直在學，卻說連第一課都未開始，前後衝突。
最近每週都看到更多蝴蝶，符合持續變化的意思。
questions.explanation: 最近每週都看到更多蝴蝶，符合持續變化的意思。

questions.meaning: 表示夢見或想像自己希望發生的事。
questions.usage: 談未來的理想，或睡覺時夢見的事情。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然表達對未來的夢想？
options: He dreams about to buy a boat for his family.
Mina dreams about opening a small flower shop one day.
I dream about becoming a baker because I never want to make food or enter a kitchen.
The robot dreams about cleaning the floor, so it has already cleaned it ten times today.
optionExplanations: about 後接 buying，不接 to buy。
想將來開花店，符合 dream about + V-ing。
口稱想做烘焙師，卻完全不願碰食物，動機矛盾。
機器人今天已多次清潔，不能由此推論它有夢想；此處擬人化也缺少語境。
questions.explanation: 想將來開花店，符合 dream about + V-ing。

questions.meaning: 用 that 子句進一步指出談的是哪些事物。
questions.usage: 想限制或說明前面名詞的範圍時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的 that 子句清楚指出所指的東西？
options: The people that I met yesterday have not met me at any time.
The cakes that my aunt made are on the table, but my aunt has never made any cakes.
The letters that Dad wrote are inside this old box.
These are the gloves that I wear on my feet to hear music.
optionExplanations: 說昨天見過，卻又說從未相遇，前後矛盾。
後面否認阿姨曾做蛋糕，推翻前面的資訊。
that Dad wrote 說明是哪一些信件，情境連貫。
手套穿在腳上聽音樂，內容不合理。
questions.explanation: that Dad wrote 說明是哪一些信件，情境連貫。

questions.meaning: 表示可能性，不把未來說得完全確定。
questions.usage: 討論未來可能發生或可能達成的事情。
questions.prompt: 哪一句用 could 表達合理的可能性？
options: I could be at the station now, and I am definitely in my kitchen right now.
The paper boat could fly to the sun tomorrow because paper is light.
With another month of practice, our team could play better.
With no water and no sun, our plant could become stronger every hour for that reason.
optionExplanations: 同時確定身在廚房，卻推測自己正在車站，兩者衝突。
紙船飛向太陽不是合理的普通可能性。
多練習可能有進步，符合 could 表示的可能性。
缺水缺陽光卻因此變強，因果不合理。
questions.explanation: 多練習可能有進步，符合 could 表示的可能性。

questions.meaning: 表示後一句與前一句形成轉折或意外結果。
questions.usage: 想說兩個不同、相反或出人意料的情況。
options: The room was quiet, but a drum suddenly started playing.
He opened the door, but the door was not closed after he opened it.
The cake is sweet, but it has sugar in it.
The chair is red, but it is not blue.
optionExplanations: 原本安靜卻突然有鼓聲，形成清楚轉折。
開門後門不再關著，是預期結果，不是對比。
糖與甜味互相支持，沒有明顯轉折。
紅色與不是藍色只是一般相容資訊，不構成明顯反差。
questions.explanation: 原本安靜卻突然有鼓聲，形成清楚轉折。

questions.meaning: 表示不再繼續某項活動。
questions.usage: 想宣告停止某個習慣或行動時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句使用 no more + V-ing 清楚表達停止？
options: No more reading today, so I will read for another five hours now.
No more running in the hall! Please run faster here.
No more running in the hall, please. Walk slowly.
No more waiting, because we have decided to wait until next week.
optionExplanations: 說今天不再閱讀，卻立即安排讀五小時，矛盾。
一方面禁止跑步，一方面要求跑快，指示矛盾。
要求不要再奔跑，並改為慢走，前後一致。
停止等待與繼續等一星期互相衝突。
questions.explanation: 要求不要再奔跑，並改為慢走，前後一致。

questions.meaning: 描述未來某時正在進行或預期持續的活動。
questions.usage: 預想某個未來時間的活動情景時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然描述未來某個時間正在做的事？
options: Tomorrow at ten, we will be watching the boats from the bridge.
At eight tomorrow, I will be cooking dinner, but I will be asleep all evening with nobody cooking.
Tomorrow night I will be painting, but I have decided not to paint at any time tomorrow.
At four, she will be flying a kite under the sea without any air.
optionExplanations: 明天十點在橋上看船，符合未來進行式。
同一時間既說煮飯又說整晚睡覺且沒人煮，互相矛盾。
明天整天都不畫畫與明晚正在畫畫衝突。
在海底放普通風箏缺乏合理條件。
questions.explanation: 明天十點在橋上看船，符合未來進行式。

questions.meaning: 用類比說明自己如何理解一件事。
questions.usage: 想形象地解釋一個抽象事物時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句使用 like 的比喻有清楚的共同特點？
options: I see my new job like a mountain: it is hard, but I can climb it step by step.
I see my homework like a cloud because it is written on paper and cannot be in the sky.
I see my bike like soup because soup tastes nice and bikes have wheels.
I see this clock like a fish because I need to drink water.
optionExplanations: 工作與登山都需要逐步克服困難，比喻清楚。
所給理由只說兩者不同，沒有解釋共同點。
單車與湯的特徵沒有形成合理比較。
時鐘與魚的對照理由不清楚。
questions.cue: I see this life like a swinging vine
questions.explanation: 工作與登山都需要逐步克服困難，比喻清楚。

questions.meaning: 直接提出要求、指示或鼓勵。
questions.usage: 給出清楚的行動指示時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的命令能合理達到目的？
options: Open the umbrella so that the rain can make us more wet.
Close your eyes to read the tiny writing on this card.
Hold the ladder while I climb it, please.
Turn off the map so we can see its paper lines better.
optionExplanations: 打開傘通常是為了不被雨淋，所說目的相反。
閉眼無法閱讀卡片上的細字，目的矛盾。
扶穩梯子能幫助別人安全攀爬，要求合理。
地圖不是可開關的設備，此處搭配不自然。
questions.cue: Swing my heart across the line
questions.explanation: 扶穩梯子能幫助別人安全攀爬，要求合理。

questions.meaning: 有時把地點或方向放句首，再讓主詞出現在動詞後；屬較文學性的倒裝。
questions.usage: 希望凸顯場景、地點或畫面時；一般說話不必常用。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的倒裝既完整又符合場景？
options: On the wall hang a large painting of a whale.
On the wall hangs a large painting of a whale.
In the box are one apple, and it is the only thing there.
Under the desk sit a small dog that is sleeping there alone.
optionExplanations: 單數 painting 應配 hangs，不能用 hang。
句首地點加 hangs 和單數主詞 painting，語法與畫面均成立。
one apple 是單數，應使用 is 而非 are。
單數 dog 應用 sits 而非 sit。
questions.cue: in my face is flashing signs
questions.explanation: 句首地點加 hangs 和單數主詞 painting，語法與畫面均成立。

questions.meaning: 先做一個動作，就可能得到後面的結果；歌詞用仿古語氣。
questions.usage: 用簡短語句鼓勵別人採取行動並說明結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句用「先做—後有結果」合理？
options: Turn the tap off and water will keep coming out faster from it.
Hide the key in the sea and you will easily find it there every day.
Eat the picture and you will learn to paint it without looking.
Plant these seeds and you will have a chance to grow flowers.
optionExplanations: 關水龍頭通常會停止出水，結果相反。
把鑰匙藏海裡通常不會更容易找到。
吃畫不能自然地帶來繪畫能力。
種下種子後有可能長花，行動與結果合理。
questions.cue: Seek it out and ye shall find
questions.explanation: 種下種子後有可能長花，行動與結果合理。

questions.meaning: 表示程度沒有別人想的那麼高。
questions.usage: 想溫和修正別人對程度的想像時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然表示「沒有那麼……」？
options: Our table is not that small; it has no space for even one cup.
This hill is not that high, so the children can walk to the top.
This bag is not that heavy, so nobody can lift it even with a machine.
The film is not that long; it lasts for seventeen days without stopping.
optionExplanations: 不算小卻一個杯子都放不下，矛盾。
小山不算很高，孩子能走上去，程度與後果一致。
不算太重卻連機器都搬不動，資訊衝突。
電影連續放十七天與「不太長」不符。
questions.explanation: 小山不算很高，孩子能走上去，程度與後果一致。

questions.meaning: 用較委婉的方式表示自己認為某件事不是如此。
questions.usage: 想表達不贊同或不確定某個說法時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的判斷與後面的理由一致？
options: I don’t think this box is empty because we opened it and found nothing at all.
I don’t think the shop is open because I am inside it buying milk right now.
I don’t think this bridge is safe because some wood is broken.
I don’t think she knows my name because she has just said it correctly ten times.
optionExplanations: 打開盒子沒有東西，反而支持盒子是空的。
正在店內購物通常顯示商店營業，理由相反。
木頭損壞是懷疑橋梁安全的合理理由。
她多次叫對名字，不支持她不知道名字。
questions.cue: I don’t think the world is sold
questions.explanation: 木頭損壞是懷疑橋梁安全的合理理由。

questions.meaning: 表示對某個想法或計畫感到信服、贊同。
questions.usage: 想表示自己是否已被某個建議說服時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然表示被某個主意說服？
options: I am sold on the ticket because the ticket bought me at the market.
I am sold on that plan because I still know nothing about it and refuse to hear any details.
The painting is sold on reading books because it has learned the alphabet.
At first I said no, but I am sold on the plan after seeing how it works.
optionExplanations: 把售票與被說服混為一談，意思錯誤。
完全不願了解內容，缺少支持已被說服的理由。
畫作不能像人一樣閱讀並形成意見。
看過計畫的運作後改變想法，符合被說服。
questions.explanation: 看過計畫的運作後改變想法，符合被說服。

questions.word: what + subject + be + past participle (embedded clause)
questions.meaning: what 引導名詞子句，表示「被告訴的事情／內容」。
questions.usage: 想把別人提供的資訊或指示當作句子中的一個部分時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然使用 what 引導「所被告知的內容」？
options: She put what she was told into a shoe as if the words were a stone.
We followed what were we told during the boat safety lesson.
I ate what I was told because a spoken instruction is a sandwich.
We followed what we were told during the boat safety lesson.
optionExplanations: 把告知內容當成實體石頭放鞋裡，缺乏合理語境。
間接子句不應倒裝成 were we told。
口頭指示不是可直接吃下的三明治。
what we were told 作 followed 的受詞，指安全課的指示。
questions.explanation: what we were told 作 followed 的受詞，指安全課的指示。

questions.meaning: 描述自己對某件事物的主觀感受。
questions.usage: 當感受未必等於客觀事實時，說明自己覺得如何。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的感受有清楚、合理的語境？
options: I feel something soft under this blanket, so I look to see what it is.
I feel the hot soup cold because it burns my tongue and is still boiling.
I feel this room is too dark to paint, so I switch off every light to make it brighter.
I feel my feet dry because I am standing in water up to my knees.
optionExplanations: feel + something + soft 表示對觸摸到的東西有主觀感受。
湯仍滾燙且燙舌，卻說感覺冰冷，矛盾。
關掉所有燈通常不能讓房間更亮。
雙腳浸在水裡卻說是乾的，語境衝突。
questions.explanation: feel + something + soft 表示對觸摸到的東西有主觀感受。

questions.meaning: 強調某種性質或感覺的程度很高。
questions.usage: 想加強描述某件事非常令人驚訝、開心或不對勁時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句自然使用 so 強調程度？
options: The music was so quiet that it made the whole town hear it from far away.
The puppet was so funny that the children laughed for a long time.
The room was so bright because all its lights were off and there were no windows.
The puppet was so funny that nobody smiled and everybody agreed it was not funny at all.
optionExplanations: 聲音很小卻遠處全鎮聽到，通常不合理。
木偶很滑稽，孩子笑很久，強調與結果一致。
無燈又無窗仍非常明亮，沒有合理光源。
說非常好笑卻全員認為一點不好笑，矛盾。
questions.explanation: 木偶很滑稽，孩子笑很久，強調與結果一致。

questions.word: V-ing phrase describing a simultaneous action
questions.meaning: 用 -ing 片語補充當時正在做的事情。
questions.usage: 想用較短的方式交代主句發生時的伴隨活動。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的 -ing 片語能合理描述同時活動？
options: Leo hurt his knee eating soup, although he was standing far away from the bowl all day and never ate.
I found my glove riding a bike, but I stayed in bed and did not touch a bike that day.
Leo hurt his knee jumping off a small wall.
She made a paper plane reading a book that she did not have.
optionExplanations: 明說整天沒有吃東西，與 eating soup 衝突。
整天沒騎車卻說騎車時找到手套，矛盾。
跳下矮牆時弄傷膝蓋，-ing 表示同時發生的動作。
在沒有書的情況下說正在讀它，資訊不一致。
questions.explanation: 跳下矮牆時弄傷膝蓋，-ing 表示同時發生的動作。

questions.meaning: 表示過去某個情況下無法做某事。
questions.usage: 描述當時的能力限制或心理上做不到時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的 couldn’t 與後面情況一致？
options: I couldn’t open the door, so I opened it easily with my finger one second later without changing anything.
We couldn’t see the stage because a tall wall was in front of us.
She couldn’t hear the song because it was playing loudly beside her and she heard every word.
We couldn’t see the stage, so we clearly watched every move from the front row with no problem.
optionExplanations: 沒有任何改變就說既打不開又輕易打開，缺乏解釋。
被高牆擋住視線，無法看見舞台合理。
稱聽不見卻又聽清每個字，前後衝突。
看不見卻又完全看清所有動作，互相矛盾。
questions.explanation: 被高牆擋住視線，無法看見舞台合理。

questions.meaning: 用關係子句界定「所有符合某條件的事情」。
questions.usage: 想概括某一類事物共同造成的影響時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句的 everything that 清楚界定範圍？
options: Everything that we planted in the small garden grew after the rain.
Everything that I can eat is a chair, so I can eat the chair for lunch.
Everything that we planted grew, but we never planted anything at all.
Everything that the dog found was a toy, but it found only rocks and no toys.
optionExplanations: 關係子句指出種過的東西，後面說它們生長，合理。
椅子不是正常食物，範圍設定不自然。
從未種過任何東西，卻說所有種過的東西都長出來，語意衝突。
所找到的全是石頭，不能同時說全是玩具。
questions.explanation: 關係子句指出種過的東西，後面說它們生長，合理。

questions.meaning: 表示某人或某事使另一人產生動作或感受。
questions.usage: 說明什麼原因讓人笑、想做事或產生感覺時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確表達「某事使某人產生反應」？
options: The loud alarm made everyone sleeping more deeply because it woke them all.
The warm sunlight made the ice stay frozen longer because it melted.
The funny dance made the children to laugh.
The funny dance made the children laugh.
optionExplanations: 警報吵醒大家，卻又說讓他們睡得更熟，矛盾。
陽光使冰融化，不能同時解釋為保持結冰更久。
使役 make 後不能用 to laugh。
滑稽舞蹈令孩子笑，make 後接原形 laugh。
questions.explanation: 滑稽舞蹈令孩子笑，make 後接原形 laugh。

questions.meaning: 表示某件事引起人的願望；歌中 wanna 是 want to 的口語形式。
questions.usage: 描述一段經歷讓自己突然想做某事。
questions.prompt: 哪一句能合理說明某事激發了一個願望？
options: The pictures of the mountains make me want to go hiking.
Hearing the quiet story makes me want to sleep, so I stay awake because I am never tired and do not want sleep.
The pictures make me want to hike because I never want to go outdoors and hate every mountain.
The great smell of bread makes me want to throw every piece away because I love eating it.
optionExplanations: 看到山景而想登山，原因與願望一致。
說想睡卻又說不想睡，願望互相否定。
說想登山卻完全不願外出也厭惡山，動機矛盾。
喜歡吃麵包卻因此想全部丟掉，缺少合理理由。
questions.explanation: 看到山景而想登山，原因與願望一致。

questions.meaning: 看著某個完整動作發生；watch 後通常不用 to。
questions.usage: 想表示目睹某個動作或過程時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確表示看著某件事發生？
options: We watched the paper boat to float across the pond.
She watched the candle go out, but she had left before it was lit and never saw it.
We watched the train leave, although we were indoors with no windows and had no view of it.
We watched the paper boat float across the pond.
optionExplanations: watch 後的受詞補語不加 to。
既沒有看到蠟燭也提前離開，不應說看見熄滅。
完全看不到火車，卻稱親眼看見它離開，矛盾。
看著紙船漂過池塘，watch + object + 原形動詞正確。
questions.explanation: 看著紙船漂過池塘，watch + object + 原形動詞正確。

questions.word: present perfect relative clause with omitted that
questions.meaning: 省略作受詞的關係代詞，補充自己曾經得到的經驗或東西。
questions.usage: 自然地描述某些自己已經學到或做過的事情時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句省略關係代詞後仍然自然、合理？
options: The songs I have learned are in this book, but I have never learned a song.
The songs I have learned are in this book. I can sing them all.
The cake I have made is ready, although I have not started making it.
The prizes I have won are on the shelf, but I have never entered any game or received any prize.
optionExplanations: 已學過的歌與從未學過歌互相衝突。
省略 that 後仍可理解為「我學過的歌」，意思一致。
稱蛋糕已完成，卻連開始製作都沒有，矛盾。
說贏過獎卻從未得獎，矛盾。
questions.explanation: 省略 that 後仍可理解為「我學過的歌」，意思一致。
